Tells whether a key is held down right now, asking for the key by its SDL scancode instead of the DirectInput code that [KeyDown](KeyDown) takes. Every key has an SDL scancode (F16 is 107, Pause is 72, the left Windows key is 227), so this reaches the keys that KeyDown cannot. The codes are the same on every platform and do not change with the keyboard layout. See Scan Codes for the table.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
While Not KeyHit(1)
	Cls
	Text 10, 10, "Press F16 (SDL scancode 107), Escape ends"
	If VKeyDown(107) Then Text 10, 30, "F16"
	Flip
Wend
```
@param scancode  The SDL scancode of the key, 1 to 511.
@param device  Only look at this keyboard, counted from 0 as in KeyboardDeviceCount. -1 (the default) means all keyboards together.
@returns 1 while the key is held down, otherwise 0.
@gap This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
